preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root must be an instance of TreeNode or None.

postconditions.description: The count of single-valued subtrees must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node.val, int) for node in traverse_tree(root))
postconditions.description: All node values in the tree must be integers.
